items.topic: Flow plus platform events for CMS callout
items.statement: Cedric proposed that a single integration user make the CMS callout so the named credentials are not shared with users, using a flow that fires a platform event (or CDC) and another flow that does the HTTP callout, instead of Apex, for maintainability.
items.quote: Cedrick Infantado: So, that uh uh I forget the the term for that. uh basically we don't want uh we don't we want to have a single user that doing the integration and um so that the the credential will not be shared with other users. I think that's the goal here. So yeah, so for the integration, I think what we need to do next is to have a flow that would fire a platform event if if that's what we want to do or even a CDC if we want that and then just use another flow to trigger the integration. / Cedrick Infantado: So I'm thinking that I'm thinking that uh a flow would be enough for now um to handle those uh these things. Uh we just want uh we just need to prep the data and then do the HTTP call out on the flow. So it's I think it's better for maintenance maintainability of of the integration.

items.quote: Kobi Kunasekaran: for for the flow approach. What how about like retries and waiting for a response to confirm that uh it actually went through and stuff.
